definition.objective: Investigate Invalid Date in the call drawer and Follow-ups. Propose one change to the full date formatter guard. Preserve valid date formatting and the existing date/time fallback. Reviewers may request release-pinned source. Use engineering-report-v1: complete assignments and impact-qualified inert proposals.
definition.title: Preserve readable dates in the call drawer and Follow-ups.
definition.problem: The full date formatter accepts out-of-range timestamps and displays Invalid Date.
definition.impact: Show captured date and time when the numeric timestamp is invalid.
criteria: Preserve the formatting of valid timestamps.
Use the existing fallback for missing or invalid timestamps.
Limit the patch to the shared call drawer and Follow-ups formatter.
